text: This major is oriented towards the country's advanced manufacturing industry, aiming to cultivate well-rounded individuals with moral integrity, intelligence, physical fitness, aesthetic appreciation, and labor skills. Students will possess a solid foundation in mathematics and natural sciences, as well as knowledge in related disciplines such as mechanics, electronics, control, computer science, artificial intelligence, and management. They will also have an international perspective and be capable of identifying, analyzing, and solving complex engineering problems in the field of intelligent manufacturing. Talents who are physically and mentally healthy, possess good moral cultivation, a sense of social responsibility and the ability for lifelong learning. After graduation, students can be engaged in the research and development, management and service of intelligent manufacturing-related products and systems in enterprises and public institutions, and be competent for positions such as the design, development and application of intelligent equipment and production lines, intelligent production control and production line operation and maintenance, and the application and service of intelligent manufacturing technology
